segments.tts: AI just claimed three of the hardest problems in science – in a single day.

On Monday, OpenAI said its models proved the local smoothing conjecture in every dimension – which would also crack two famous math puzzles, Kakeya and Stein's restriction. Plus new claims in computer science and physics. The math comes with computer-checked proofs, but experts haven't reviewed it yet.
Next: Google DeepMind's Genie 4 turns a text prompt into a world you can explore – now with sound and dialogue, and you can change the weather while you play.
Quick hit: Meta reportedly built a humanoid home robot called Max in just three months, with five-fingered hands for picking up bottles and toys.
Proofs, worlds, robots – all in seven days.
